cost_usd.description: Cost from the price table, null when unknown.

kind.description: api = billed by the tool; chat = a chat-road render, never summed.

tag.description: The unit of work (a video and batch, a record id), for the log.

cache_read.description: Prompt tokens served from the vendor's prompt cache (counted inside tokens_in).

cache_write.description: Prompt tokens written to the vendor's prompt cache.

invocation.description: The verb label of the invocation that made the call (a tool's command and action), for a tool whose usage report groups by it.

run.description: One id shared by every line an invocation wrote, so a report can count invocations.

client.description: The provenance key of the client that drove the invocation (engine, session, precision), for a tool that attributes spend to a chat.
